title: Context Relay Fence and Idempotent Hook for Mixed-Framework Runtimes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Mixed-framework services (Node async handlers, Python worker pools, and Go GRPC gateways) show duplicated or missing trace headers when requests traverse multiple instrumented layers, causing noisy spans, sampling mismatches, and incorrect parent relationships. Goal: implement a lightweight "context relay fence" mechanism plus an idempotent instrumentation hook that prevents double-injection, preserves original parent ids across async turn-taking, and is portable across our language SDKs with minimal runtime cost. Deliverables: 1) language-agnostic fence design and spec, 2) SDK patch for Node/Python/Go with a new Hook API, 3) middleware adapters for express/fastapi/grpc, 4) test harness and perf benchmarks, 5) docs and migration notes for teams.
tasks: Draft fence design doc with canonical request lifecycle diagram and header canonicalization rules
Define Hook API: onRequestStart, onRequestResume, onRequestFinish with idempotency token semantics
Implement Node SDK hook + express middleware adapter
Implement Python SDK hook + ASGI/WSGI middleware adapter
Implement Go SDK hook + grpc/http middleware adapter
Add unit tests for idempotent header injection and multi-hop propagation
End-to-end test between example gateway -> worker -> cache that validates parent-child relationships
Benchmark overhead at 1k/5k/10k RPS and measure P50/P95/P99 latency delta
Create migration guide and breaking-change annex for teams
Open PRs and coordinate rollout gating with runtime-1.20 canary
acceptance_criteria: New Hook API documented and accepted in design review
Node/Python/Go SDKs include idempotent hook implementations behind feature flag
Unit and integration tests confirm no duplicate trace headers in async handoffs
E2E parent/child span correctness validated in example microservice topology
Perf: CPU overhead <0.5% and P99 latency regression <2ms at 5k RPS on dedicated test harness
No regressions in existing sampling behavior and trace correlation dashboards remain stable
Migration doc published and at least two internal teams signed up for early rollout
